title: Průvodce FAIR daty / FAIR Data Guide (EOSC CZ)
description:
An interactive Czech and English guide that leads researchers, data stewards, repository administrators and research communities along the path to FAIR data. It builds on the FAIR analysis for the National Repository Platform and the National Data Infrastructure (NRP/NDI, version 1.2) and reflects the current state of national services. Its content is published as an RO-Crate knowledge base with paradata.

Online guide: https://dsw-nrp.github.io/eosc-fair-guide/
Source code: https://github.com/dsw-nrp/eosc-fair-guide
